changes.title: Rebuild row caches with reserved metadata
changes.text: A CRC-valid derived row cache using a reserved flag or tag now fails closed and is rebuilt from the unchanged raw history instead of silently interpreting unknown metadata as ordinary defaults. Valid caches continue to decode exactly.

changes.title: Retain strict row-cache metadata coverage
changes.text: Seven focused tests preserve one valid cache fixture and reject reserved log flags, log ruleset tags, merge-key markers, row flags, row ruleset tags and cell kinds. The complete core suite passed before requesting the full Android gate.

changes.title: Preserve the TEST273 Developer and Player pair evidence
changes.text: The intervening private Player build and labeled-pair packaging remain evidence-only and did not alter the application behavior being compared. Both APK labels and their receipts are retained.
